column1: # Check-mode fn-body analysis. A user fn's body is analysed under the
# carrier args (params bound carrier-typed); its diagnostics propagate,
# and the call's result is the declared return type. A param-type
# violation at the call site assumes the signature and emits no_signature
# (plus any further violations the body analysis surfaces).

column3: body addq n 1 clean; declared return Integer
String arg: param + body addq both fail
body concatq n '!' violates (n is Integer)
